description: Copy of the org preset renovate/default.json in Miragon/github-governance. This repo is public, and the Mend Renovate App does not load presets from private repos for public ones.
Keep it in line with the org preset.

customManagers.description: Ubuntu version of Ubicloud runners, e.g. runs-on: ubicloud-standard-2-ubuntu-2404. Labels without a version (ubicloud-standard-2) follow Ubicloud's default and stay untouched.

ubicloud-ubuntu.description: Ubuntu versions Ubicloud offers runners for, read from the label list in the Ubicloud repo.

packageRules.description: @actions/glob >= 0.6 and @actions/core >= 3 ship as ES modules only. The action builds to CommonJS with ncc, which then leaves them unbundled and dist/index.js fails at start. Lift this once src/ is migrated to ESM.
typescript-eslint supports TypeScript <6.1.0 only (8.72.1). Hold TypeScript below 7 and lift this once typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
Ubicloud's label list has no release timestamps. Without this rule the update would stay pending on minimumReleaseAge.

Only Docker Hub reports release timestamps. Images from gcr.io, ghcr.io, quay.io and other registries come without delay instead of staying pending on minimumReleaseAge forever (Miragon/github-governance#14).
